To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the protein kinase D1 regulates actin dynamics by phosphorylation of the actin binding protein slingshot.
protein kinase D1 regulates cofilin-mediated actin reorganization and directed cell migration via slingshot.
the protein kinase PKD1 phosphorylates the SSH phosphatase SSH1L, and thereby inhibits cofilin-mediated actin severing and lamellipodial protrusion.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a novel regulatory mechanism for the spatiotemporal regulation of cofilin- and F-actin-dependent processes in migrating cells.

a novel mechanism of cofilin regulation, in which PKD1 phosphorylates SSH1L to prevent its localization to F-actins in the lamellapodium and thus blocks the formation of free barbed ends and lamellapodium protrusion.
a new mechanism of crosstalk between PKD1 and ADF/cofilin signalling that regulates F-actin dynamics and directed cell migration in invasive tumour cell lines.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the PKD1-mediated phosphorylation of SSH1L at Ser-173 blocks its localization to the lamellipodia and thereby inhibits cofilin-mediated actin filament severing.
PKD1 phosphorylates SSH1L at Ser(158) and thus prevents its localization at the lamellipodia, which results in an inhibition of cofilin-mediated actin severing and cell motility.

PKD1 phosphorylates and inhibits the actin-binding activity of the actin depolymeric phosphatase SSH, thereby blocking cofilin dephosphorylatiion and actin filament barbed end generation and directed cell migration.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
PKD1 regulates cofilin mediated F actin reorganization and directed cell motile processes via Slingshot.
PKD1 is a negative regulator of SSH1L and cofilin-mediated actin remodellin.
PKD1 is an essential regulator of SSH1L-mediated actin severing and cell migration.
The main takeaway from our work is that
PKD1 acts as an upstream regulator of SSH1L, and thus, cofilin-mediated actin severing.
PKD1 regulates the activity of SSH1L by controlling its localization to F-actins and thus modulates the actin dynamics and cell motility.
PKD1 regulates cofilin-mediated F-actin dynamics and cell motility by controlling SSH1L activity.
